== '''Overview''' ==
'''Acidgrinder''' is a rod that was obtained from completing [[Axel]]'s quests at the [[Underground Music Venue]]. It has mediocre stats all round and a very unique passive, somewhat similar to [[Maelstrom Rod|Maelstrom]] with the 'hold input' mechanic. This rod resembles a chainsaw with green and purple glowing effects. These effect resemble paint splatters.

== '''Obtainment''' ==
Was obtainable by complete [[Axel|Axel's]] Quests:

# Catch {{Mutation|Tainted}} [[Brine Phantom]]
# Catch {{Mutation|Brined}} [[Brine Sovereign]] (Completing this rewards {{Rarity|Apex|Restricted}} '''Acidgrinder''')
# Catch and return 1 {{Mutation|Acidic}} [[Caustic Starwyrm]] with Acidgrinder
Competing all three quests will reward unrestricted '''Acidgrinder'''

== '''Passives''' ==

* '''40%''' chance for {{Mutation|Acidic}} mutation (7.3x)
* Holding an input will increase charge, with letting go decreasing charge. Charge gives boosts to progress speed (25%) and forced progress speed (25%). '''(50%)'''

== '''Enchantments''' ==

* {{Enchantment|Herculean}} + {{Enchantment|Cryogenic}} to increase Control and a chance to freeze fish.
* {{Enchantment|Piercing}} + {{Enchantment|Cryogenic}} to have passive Stab ability and a chance to freeze fish.
* {{Enchantment|Ferocious}} + {{Enchantment|Vicious}} to increase Disturbance to activate server events like '''Brine Storm'''.
